data.body:
RCA + repair (rebar-debug protocol).

FINDING: bridge fsck alerting unbound_jira=[REB-3510] — Jira issue carries label rebar-id:jira-reb-3510 but no local ticket and no binding existed.

ROOT CAUSE (proven): GHA reconcile run 32602702883 (2026-08-22T22:32Z) adopted REB-3510 — wrote the local CREATE + binding and stamped the Jira label (issue updated 22:36Z) — then its FINAL tickets push was rejected non-fast-forward ('final-push-rejected … 7 unpushed commits' in the run log) and the ephemeral runner was destroyed, losing all local state. No pass-persist commit exists for the 21:35Z-23:36Z window in tracker history. The drift cannot self-heal: binding_walk L10 guard and differ bug-4354 suppression both stand down on the rebar-id label, and BindingRecovery.recover_pending_bindings only walks 'pending' store entries (also lost with the runner).

CLASSIFICATION: data-level drift from an operational push race (env_integration) — not a bridge/fsck code defect, not self-healed (fsck re-run confirmed the finding persisted).

REPAIR (supported doors, per precedent abducent-pictorial-angora / 16c1-0f0c): replayed the lost inbound-create through the reconciler's own leaf _apply_inbound_create with client=None (NO Jira mutation — the label is already correct), then BindingStore.save() + commit_and_push_tickets_branch. Tracker commit 3a96299387: signed CREATE event for jira-reb-3510 (bot identity 594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d, priority Medium->2, creation_channel jira, tags [imported:reconciler-bootstrap]) + bidirectional binding + seeded baseline. Jira status 'To Do' maps to local 'open', so no STATUS event needed.

VERIFICATION: post-repair 'rebar bridge fsck --output json' is clean — alerting={}, store_integrity=[] (1483 non-alerting absent_in_window_unprobed, unchanged baseline).

NOTE: delivery of the tracker commit to origin/tickets was delayed by a sustained CLAIM_ENRICH push flood from a concurrent enrich-drain clone; the repair is durably committed in the canonical tracker and pushes on the first lull. Systemic defect (Jira label stamped before durable local publish; marked-but-unstored keys unrecoverable) filed as a discovered_from ticket.
